title: Community section layout verified
summary: Fix the cramped empty-post panel and improve the mobile community heading.

changes.detail: Replace empty dark panel with a light, evenly padded state, removing the top-edge collision, nested borders and excessive shadow.
Use fluid mobile heading size and relaxed line height. Add an accessible section heading and anchor scroll clearance. Reduce mobile section whitespace.
Hide publication-specific footer text when no publication exists; retain actual published-post rendering.
